# FAQ
FAQs section provides quick answers to common Aadhaar-related queries on enrolment, updates, authentication, e-KYC, security, Aadhaar App, biometric lock/unlock, online services, documents required, status tracking and resident support services.

Find answers to frequently asked questions about the Aadhaar App, including registration, login, profile management, document sharing, QR code verification, security features, troubleshooting, and other services available through the app for a seamless Aadhaar experience.

Authentication
Authentication verifies an Aadhaar holder’s identity using demographic or biometric information through the CIDR securely and digitally.
Read More
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
Direct Benefit Transfer enables secure and efficient delivery of subsidies, benefits and services using Aadhaar-based identity verification and authentication.
Read More
CRM Division
CRM Division assists residents through calls, email, chatbot, web portal, social media and grievance channels for Aadhaar support services.
Read More
Aadhaar Online Services
Explore Aadhaar Online Services including e-Aadhaar download, VID generation, address update, biometric lock/unlock, authentication history, Aadhaar PVC Card, offline e-KYC and more. Access secure, convenient and resident-friendly digital services anytime, anywhere.
Read More
OVSE
Find answers to frequently asked questions about the Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE) framework, including registration requirements, technical specifications, onboarding process, Aadhaar offline verification methods, use cases, compliance obligations, integration guidelines, security features, and support resources for organizations seeking secure, consent-based identity verification without connecting to UIDAI’s CIDR.
